title: DevAcademy lesson.yaml
description: Editor aid only. The C# ContentValidator is authoritative (unique ids, acyclic prerequisites, theory sections, test counts, ...).

seeAlso.description: Free text for topics that do not exist yet.

assessmentFor.description: Placement quiz: passing it credits these lessons (source Assessment). Requires a quiz.

answer.description: single: option index; multiple: [indices]; short: [accepted strings]; numeric: number.

complexity.description: Algorithm problems: shown after the exercise is passed.

editorial.description: Path (relative to the lesson directory) of a Markdown write-up. Shown only after the exercise is passed or after explicit confirmation. Requires an exercise.

requires.description: Default for the lesson's exercise and challenge when they declare no `requires` of their own.

accelerator.description: Default for the lesson's exercise and challenge.

requires.description: Environment requirements. python/packages (Python exercises): checked with importlib.metadata in the learner's active Python environment (never imported). node/npmPackages (javascript exercises): checked against the node content environment (`make node-env`, Settings -> Runtimes). go/goModules (go exercises): checked against the Go module cache of a go package set (`make go-env`, Settings -> Runtimes). Missing ones block the run with install instructions. Offline stdlib-only exercises declare nothing.

items.description: Name plus optional extras and version clauses; no URLs, markers or options.
Plain npm package name (scoped allowed); the installed version is pinned by the package set's package-lock.json (tools/content-packages/node/<set>).

go.description: Go toolchain version specifier (go exercises), checked against the installed `go`.

memoryMb.description: Memory limit (MB) of one run of the exercise (Run button, grading, theory samples checked by validate-content). Default 256. Only for libraries whose import alone is close to the default (PyTorch); does not change the network or write restrictions.

items.description: Go module path (no version); one go package set (tools/content-packages/go/<set>/go.mod + go.sum) must provide all of them. The exercise ships its own go.mod and go.sum with the same pins.

accelerator.description: none: CPU only (default). optional: runs on CPU, may use a GPU. required: disabled, with an explanation, when no framework backend (CUDA, ROCm, MPS, ...) is confirmed in the active environment.

variants.description: Several languages for the same exercise (tests, prompt and hints are shared). Key = language id. Cannot be combined with top-level languageId/entryFile/starter/solution/harness/harnessEntry.

evaluation.description: command: a real test tool (node --test, go test) grades a multi-file exercise; see `command`, `tests_dir` and `tests[].match`.

command.description: evaluation: command only. Either `run`: the executable (run[0]) must be a known tool of the language: node (javascript, with --test) or go (go test); or `tool` + `args`: a tool from the node content environment (vitest) whose script path the runner supplies. Runs sandboxed, no network, in a fresh directory holding the learner's files plus the files of tests_dir; node_modules is a read-only link to the content environment.

tool.description: Runs `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run <args>`. Needs requires.npmPackages to list it, report: junit and args with --reporter=junit and --outputFile=<reportFile>.

args.description: Allowlisted flags only (--reporter=, --outputFile=, --config=, --pool=threads|forks, --environment=jsdom|node, --testTimeout=, --maxWorkers=, --no-file-parallelism, --silent, --passWithNoTests, --globals) and relative file filters.

report.description: junit: JUnit XML from reportFile (or stdout). go-test-json: `go test -json` events from stdout.

reportFile.description: Relative path of the JUnit report written by the command. Not allowed for go-test-json.

testsTarget.description: Directory (inside the work directory) the files of tests_dir are copied to; "." = the root (Go tests live next to the package).

tests_dir.description: evaluation: command only. Hidden test files copied in at grading time; never shown in the editor.

tests.description: At least one public and one hidden test (not required for command).

stdin.description: Inline input. Mutually exclusive with stdinFile.

stdinFile.description: Path (relative to the lesson directory) of a UTF-8 file with the input, at most 16 MB. Use it for data larger than ~4 KB, e.g. tests/large-1.in.

expected.description: Required for io (or expectedFile). Mutually exclusive with expectedFile.

expectedFile.description: Path (relative to the lesson directory) of a UTF-8 file with the expected output, at most 16 MB.

match.description: evaluation: command only (required there). The reported test name this case maps to: JUnit testcase name, "suite > name" or "classname.name"; Go test name such as TestMean/empty. A trailing * matches by prefix.
